info.title: StockPros Platform API
info.description: AI-powered stock forecasting, portfolio analytics, and decision-support platform backend.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's watchlist with current quotes and AI suggestion data.

post.description: Add a stock symbol to the authenticated user's watchlist.

put.description: Update trade plan fields (target entry, stop-loss, notes) for a watchlist symbol.

delete.description: Remove a symbol from the watchlist.

post.description:
Trigger AI suggestion calculation for a watchlist symbol.
Computes suggested entry price, take-profit, and stop-loss from technical analysis.

get.description: Get all alerts configured for a watchlist symbol.

post.description:
Create a new alert for a watchlist symbol.
Supports 12 alert types: price thresholds, analyst changes, SEC filings, earnings, dividends, and AI signals.

get.description:
Search for stock symbols or company names (autocomplete).
Powered by Finnhub symbol search with US exchange filter by default.
Fetch paginated notifications for the authenticated user, newest first.

delete.description: Delete all notifications for the authenticated user.

get.description: Get the count of unread notifications for the authenticated user.
Get the authenticated user's notification preferences.

patch.description: Update the authenticated user's notification preferences.

post.description: Mark a specific notification as read.
Mark all notifications as read for the authenticated user.

get.description:
Fetch a paginated list of financial news articles.
Supports filtering by symbol, sentiment, category, and full-text search.

post.description: Mark a news article as read for the authenticated user.
Save or unsave a news article (toggle bookmark).

delete.description: Remove a saved article from the user's saved list.

get.description: Fetch all saved articles for the authenticated user.

post.description: Mark all unread articles as read.

get.description:
Get ranked top US stocks ordered by a composite score (volume, momentum, market cap).
Results are cached for performance.

post.description:
Fetch live quote snapshots for a batch of symbols.
Pulls from the in-memory PriceCache (updated via Finnhub WebSocket) with Yahoo Finance fallback.
Resolve company sectors and industry classification for a list of symbols.
Fetch cached logo URLs for a batch of symbols. Missing logos fall back to Clearbit.

Generate a GRU-based time-series stock price forecast.
Delegates to the Python AI Service which trains/loads a GRU model on Tiingo OHLCV data.
Results are cached in Redis to avoid redundant inference.

get.description: Retrieve paginated forecast history for the authenticated user.
Fetch a single historical forecast record by ID.
Export a forecast result as a CSV file.

post.description:
Run the full multi-factor decision engine for a user's portfolio.
Combines technical indicators (RSI, Bollinger Bands), analyst ratings, news sentiment,
earnings data, and portfolio exposure to produce BUY/SELL/HOLD recommendations.

Upload a portfolio CSV or XLSX file for batch position import.
Accepted columns: symbol, quantity, avgEntryPrice, sector.

get.description: Fetch paginated history of decision runs for the authenticated user.
Fetch a single decision run by ID including all per-symbol results.

delete.description: Delete a specific decision run record.

get.description:
Get a comprehensive dashboard summary: portfolio metrics, market movers, and recent activity.
Combines data from multiple modules for a single-request page load.
Get real-time market overview including top gainers, losers, and most active stocks.

post.description: Send a magic link login email. A one-time link will be emailed to the address.
Verify a magic link token and return JWT access token + session cookie.
Authenticate via Google Identity Services (ID token credential).
Complete user onboarding after magic link / OAuth signup.

401.description: Missing, expired, or invalid refresh token

post.description: Rotate session — exchange a valid refresh_token cookie for a new access token and rotated refresh token cookie.
Invalidate the current session (clears the refresh_token cookie).

get.description: Fetch the authenticated user's full profile including roles and preferences.

put.description: Partially update the authenticated user's profile.

post.description: Upload a profile avatar image (multipart/form-data).

get.description: List all defined roles and their associated permissions.

post.description: Create a new role.

delete.description: Delete a role and revoke it from all assigned users.

post.description: Assign a role to a user.
Revoke a role from a user.

get.description: Get the permission matrix for the currently authenticated user.
